parcels_counties.notes: City of Cranston parcels in RIGIS standard format joined to the assessor CAMA extract (tax roll year in CAMAExtract_TaxRollYear). Rhode Island has no county government; parcels are kept by the 39 cities and towns.

parcels_counties.name: City of Providence - Parcels w CAMA
parcels_counties.notes: Municipality, not a county: Rhode Island parcel data is kept by city/town, so the 'county' field holds the municipality name. Published by the City of Providence GIS office on ArcGIS Online (item owner PVDGIS_Admin, item last modified Sept 2024); parcels in RIGIS standard format joined to the assessor CAMA extract, TaxRollYear 2023 in the samples, so the ownership is about three years old. PROPID is the plat-lot-unit id (e.g. 019-0102-0407); condominium units are separate records on one lot. Numeric values are stored as text (AssessedValueTotal '226900', AreaAC '0.073830'). SalePrice, SaleDate, MuniUseCodeDesc, YearBuilt also present. Spatial point+distance query works as-is (native wkid 102730/3438): 1,166 records at -71.4128,41.8240 (.../query?geometry=-71.4128,41.8240&geometryType=esriGeometryPoint&inSR=4326&spatialRel=esriSpatialRelIntersects&distance=200&units=esriSRUnit_Meter&outFields=*&returnGeometry=false&f=json). A sibling service Parcels_with_CAMA (44,161 records, same fields) exists in the same organization. The ArcGIS Online item has no licence or description text and no city terms page was found.

summary: Projects: only an outdated STIP map service (FFY2018-2027, 2020 amendment) and a small LRTP proposed-projects layer were found; no current RIDOT planned-projects GIS service was verified. Parcels: no statewide owner layer (RIGIS publishes none; parcels are municipal, many on vendor viewers without open services); only Cranston's city layer with owner and mailing address was verified, Providence was not found. Second pass 2026-11-17: Providence city parcels with owner and mailing address verified (2023 tax roll) and answering spatial queries; Warwick has linework only, Pawtucket only 63 city-owned parcels, and there is still no statewide owner layer.

parcels_counties_checked.restrictions: not reviewed: layer not usable (63 parcels)
parcels_counties_checked.notes: Municipality, not a county. Not a citywide layer: only 63 parcels owned by the City of Pawtucket and the Pawtucket Redevelopment Agency (OWN_NAME1, MAD_MAIL_A...). No citywide Pawtucket parcel service was found among the city's 44 public ArcGIS Online services.

Re-checked 2026-11-17: no statewide parcel layer with owners. The RIGIS ArcGIS Online organization (services2.arcgis.com/S8zZg9pg23JUEexQ, 465 services) has only coastal sea-level-rise (SLAMM) parcel subsets, and the state server risegis.ri.gov/hosting lists no parcel service (its Hosted folder needs a token).
